753:t_034:4.en:
$n
「Now that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ has lost his power, I should be able to do it...!」

753:t_034:5.en:
$n
「I'll seize control of $$至高神Ｚ$$ with the $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

753:t_034:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's insane! You'd have to take in all the souls of $$エス・テラン$$ by yourself!」

753:t_034:7.en:
$n
「$$桂$$, $$オルソン$$, $$ツィーネ$$! The $$黒い太陽#sol$$... the $$超特異点$$ should be inside this thing!」

753:t_034:8.en:
$n
「I'm begging you! Please save the universe with $$時空修復$$!」

753:t_034:10.en:
$n
「Every living being in the universe must want to live! It'll work!」

753:t_034:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're no higher-dimensional being! Your existence would be absorbed into the flow of $$オリジン・ロー$$ and vanish beyond the causal horizon!」

753:t_034:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You would be cast completely outside the natural order and could never be reincarnated again!!」

753:t_034:15.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're... not afraid to cease existing...」

753:t_034:16.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So this is... what it means to stake your life...」

753:t_035:3.en:
$n
「I'm just giving back the life you all saved.」

753:t_035:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You idiot! Who asked you to do that?!」

753:t_035:6.en:
$n
「$$キタン$$ and $$ゼロ$$ staked their lives too! So will I...!」

753:t_036:3.en:
$n
「I'm just giving back the life you all saved.」

753:t_036:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You idiot! Who asked you to do that?!」

753:t_036:6.en:
$n
「$$キタン$$, Major $$グラハム$$ and $$ゼロ$$ staked their lives too! So will I...!」

753:t_037:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Did you forget? I can teleport short distances.」

753:t_037:2.en:
$n
「Why did you come back?! Now I can't...」

753:t_037:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I have two conflicting personalities! I'm sure I can seize the Supreme God with the $$いがみ合う双子$$' power too!」

753:t_037:6.en:
$n
「Then there's no point! I wanted to save you, Miss $$スズネ$$...!」

753:t_037:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you think I can just stand by when the person I love tells me he's going to die right in front of me?!」

753:t_037:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「I can't watch this! You're having a lovers' spat while the whole universe is about to collapse!」

753:t_038:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're dead wrong if you think you're the only $$いがみ合う双子$$ Reactor, $n!」

753:t_038:3.en:
$$シン$$
「You're not the only one who's fought while overcoming conflicting feelings!」

753:t_038:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I told you when we fought the evil gods! All of us are here because we overcame hope and despair!」

753:t_038:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「So we'll all use the $$いがみ合う双子$$' power together!」

753:t_038:7.en:
$n
「...I'm sure we can... Because the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$ is humanity itself.」

753:t_038:9.en:
$n
「The twelve $$スフィア$$s are humanity's emotions... Their sentient union, $$太極$$, is humanity itself, living with contradictions.」

753:t_038:10.en:
$n
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$ is like a miniature $$太極$$... I think that's why it forms the core of the twelve $$スフィア$$s.」

753:t_038:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief, $$ＡＧ$$! Use the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to connect our minds to $n!」

753:t_038:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll all hold $$至高神Ｚ$$ down together!」

753:t_038:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「While we're at it, we'll gather the wishes of everyone in the universe who wants to live and perform $$時空修復$$ too!」

753:t_038:15.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm ready! $$オルソン$$, $$ツィーネ$$, you two ready too?!」

753:t_038:17.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「This will end everything that began with the $$大時空震動$$!」

753:t_038:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll make it happen! Even if the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ shatters!」

753:t_038:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's too early to smile yet.」

753:t_038:22.en:
$$万丈$$
「We're repairing every world born from the $$大時空震動$$. We have no idea what will happen.」

753:t_038:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah! I won't accept the universe coming to an end!」

753:t_038:25.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm sure everyone feels the same way!」

753:t_038:26.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We'll take in all their hopes!」

753:t_038:27.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll all do this together! For the people we love and the world we must protect!」

753:t_038:28.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go! The universe's biggest show is starting!」

753:t_038:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
「For the future of every world!」

753:t_038:30.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll make a miracle happen now!」
